name: cklph-audit
description: Adversarially verified whole-repo security audit. Lenses: security, correctness, architecture, sca, iac, container, k8s, supply-chain, compliance, concurrency, state-machine, economic, llm, data-isolation, web-auth, client-side, messaging, availability; opt-in docs-drift, omission, agent-config, ambiguity. Scanners find candidates, Claude judges them, a separate verifier tries to refute each. Optional sandboxed exploit and patch steps. SOC 2 and CASA compliance matrix. Read-only by default.
